facts.text: Nobody touches my seat, and nobody touches the good snacks. I mean it, Quill.
facts.why: Rocket does not say this in the film. His real lines on the quote page are things like 'You got issues, Quill.'

vibe.verdict: A solid galley menu that uses the mixtape, the Kyln, Groot in his pot and the dance-off well.
missing: Peter's Walkman and the Awesome Mix tape (it is in the cue only)
Rocket's prison break plan with Groot
Drax taking metaphors literally (house line only)
ideas: Add a 'Walkman toast' to the starters, replacing 'Awesome Mix pepperoni pizza rolls' note so the tape is on the food.
Swap 'Galaxy punch' note for 'blue and red layered like Ronan's ship lights'.
Replace the cue with 'Serve the snacks when Quill hits play on the Walkman at the Kyln' to be more specific.
